containerpeek.search.title: Storage Search
containerpeek.search.empty_world: Nothing here yet! Open your chests, barrels and shulker boxes, and Container Peek will remember what's inside.
containerpeek.search.select_item: Select an item to see where it is.
containerpeek.search.select_container: Select a container to see what's inside.
containerpeek.search.hint_items: Click a location to walk there · Double-click an item to highlight all · ↑↓ and Enter work too
containerpeek.search.hint_containers: Double-click a container to walk there · Hover items for details · ↑↓ and Enter work too
containerpeek.search.sort.name: Name
containerpeek.config.title: Container Peek Settings
containerpeek.config.tab.label: Label
containerpeek.config.enabled.desc: Turns all of Container Peek on or off. What it remembers is kept either way.
containerpeek.config.remember.desc: Record names and contents when you open or place containers. Turn off to stop learning new ones (what's already known still shows).
containerpeek.config.forget_broken.desc: When a container you know is broken or picked up, forget it. Turn off to keep its last contents in search.
containerpeek.config.show_names.desc: Show a container's custom name (from an anvil).
containerpeek.config.show_contents.desc: Show the items inside as icons.
containerpeek.config.show_unknown_hint.d: For containers you haven't opened yet, show "open once to remember".
containerpeek.config.shulker_tooltip.des: Hovering a shulker box item shows its contents as a 9×3 grid of icons instead of a text list.
containerpeek.config.shulker_shift.desc: Show the grid only while Shift is held; otherwise the normal text list.
containerpeek.config.position.desc: Where on screen the label goes.
containerpeek.config.y_offset.desc: How far the label sits from the crosshair or screen edge.
containerpeek.config.max_icons.desc: Most different items shown; the rest become "+N".
containerpeek.config.icons_per_row.desc: Wrap to a new row after this many icons.
containerpeek.config.show_more.desc: Show how many more kinds there are when they don't all fit.
containerpeek.config.count_format.desc: Short ("1.7k") or exact ("1728") totals under the icons.
containerpeek.config.background.desc: Draw a dark panel behind the label so it's readable on bright blocks.
How dark the panel behind the label is.
containerpeek.config.max_distance.desc: Only show the label for containers within this distance.
containerpeek.config.hide_sneaking.desc: Hide the label while you're sneaking (handy when it's in the way).
containerpeek.config.containers_note: Choose which containers get a label when you look at them. Hidden ones are still remembered and searchable.
containerpeek.config.show_all.desc: Turn labels on for every container type.
containerpeek.config.hide_all.desc: Turn labels off for every container type.
containerpeek.config.kind.desc: Show the label when looking at a %s.
containerpeek.config.search_note: Open Storage Search with Y (change it in Options → Controls → Key Binds → Container Peek). Click a result to have the locator walk you there.
containerpeek.config.locator_beam.desc: A tall line above each container you're being guided to. It's hidden by walls like normal blocks; the waypoint markers aren't.
containerpeek.config.locator_reach.desc: How close you need to get for a container to count as found and stop being marked.
containerpeek.config.strip_position.desc: Where the arrow and distance strip goes.
containerpeek.config.found_sound.desc: Play a sound as you reach each container.
containerpeek.config.data_note: Container Peek's memory is saved in config/containerpeek.json, separately for each server and world.
containerpeek.config.forget_world.desc: Forget every container remembered on the server or world you're in.
containerpeek.config.forget_world.confir: Forget every container remembered on this server or world? You'll need to open them again.
containerpeek.config.forget_all.desc: Forget every container on every server and world.
containerpeek.config.forget_all.confirm: Forget every container on every server and world? This can't be undone.
containerpeek.config.open_folder.desc: Open the folder with Container Peek's files.
containerpeek.config.locator_markers.des: Show each container you're looking for as an icon with its distance on screen, visible through walls. When it's behind you or off-screen, the marker sits at the edge with an arrow pointing the way.
